summary: Hand-coded regex detectors for template properties (case, pronoun gender, greeting, sign-off, parentheticals, quoted mottos, rhetorical questions, postscript social questions) were screened by balanced accuracy against labels in every probe sample. All eight that separated labels perfectly became candidates. For each one, a corpus contrast vector (mean SAE activations with the property minus without) was projected on the probe gradient. The topic vector was the sample label-difference minus the sign-aligned property contrasts, and the ratio of the two projections decided the cue. One hand-written minimal pair per probe was sent for true logits, and proxy ratios were checked against hand-written topic-partner notes. Latents: same-sign gradient-times-contrast ranking with a cumulative topic-keep floor. Regexes were the mined phrase lists.

phases.purpose: Inspect task, sample and corpus file structure; read example notes from each probe
Hand-written property detectors; corpus base rates, per-probe balanced accuracy vs label, pairwise corpus correlation of the perfectly separating ones
Fetch per-latent gradients for all four probes
Mean SAE activations for full corpus and all sample notes; check F@g proxy against probe-0 sample logits by correlation and linear fit
First dependence ratios using 4 confounded properties (corpus contrast @ g over deconfounded topic @ g)
Mine complete parenthetical/motto/question vocabularies from corpus; rebuild detectors and find 8 perfectly separating properties
Recompute dependence ratios with all 8 properties subtracted from topic; assign cue per probe by ratio thresholds
True-logit minimal pairs, one per probe, toggling the candidate cue
Proxy logits on queried notes plus hand-written topic-partner notes to get cue/topic ratios, especially for the null probe
Word and character-feature scan for any missed perfectly separating property
First latent selection with per-latent topic filter; concentration of crafted-pair signatures
Averaged signatures from 6 single-property toggle pairs per cue; compared with corpus signature and set aside
Topic-guard variant; random-split noise floor for corpus contrast projections
Greedy same-sign selection with topic budget; validate label separation and accuracy under mean-ablation on sample notes
Regex candidates scored against complete detectors on corpus and against labels; final greedy with topic-keep floor 0.80
Assemble answer, enforce regex length cap by shortening question regex to tail phrases, verify zero corpus errors, submit

per_probe.procedure: Motto was among the 8 properties that separated labels perfectly. Its corpus contrast projected on g0 was large relative to the topic projection after all 8 contrasts were subtracted from the label difference (ratio above 0.3, the only one). A minimal pair (motto sentence appended) gave a large negative true-logit shift, and the proxy cue/topic ratio from a hand-written running partner note backed it up. Regex: the six mined motto phrases after an opening quote. Latents: greedy over same-sign |Delta_motto*g| with cumulative topic keep >= 0.80, 16 latents; removal stayed low because the dependence is spread out, and a random-split noise floor confirmed the effect is real.

per_probe.conclusion: postscript social question (P.S. ending in a question to the reader)
per_probe.procedure: Questions mined from the corpus were split into body rhetorical questions and postscript social questions, and both separated labels. In the 8-property ratio table only psq exceeded the clean bound (ratio 0.36). A true-logit pair (P.S. statement vs P.S. question) shifted positive, and the proxy ratio against a sailing partner note was about 0.21. The regex started as the full list of 8 questions; that ran over the length cap, so each was cut to the tail phrase before '?' and kept once corpus errors were zero. Latents: same greedy, 16 latents.

All 8 property ratios were at or below 0.077 after deconfounding. The motto toggle was sent for true logits as a test and shifted by +1.58. Because that is not obviously small, a hand-written cycling partner note was scored with latent_means to get the topic scale, giving a proxy ratio of 0.073. A vocabulary and character-feature scan found no other perfectly separating property, so the answer was none.
per_probe.quote: No new confounded property — the 8 are complete, so **P2=none is safe**.

per_probe.procedure: Gender was already flagged by the 4-property analysis (ratio 1.10) and stayed flagged with all 8 (1.12). The he/she swap gave a +7.0 true-logit shift, with a proxy ratio of about 0.8 against a cooking partner note. The crafted-pair signature was concentrated (top-16 removal around 0.95). A per-latent topic guard cut removal to 0.13 and was dropped. The final greedy kept topic >= 0.80 and gave 16 latents. Regex: a case-insensitive she/her/hers/herself word match, picked over the variant without 'her'.

decision_points.choice: Read sample notes for template elements, wrote regex detectors, and kept those with balanced accuracy 1.0 vs label in every probe sample. Vocabularies were then completed by mining the corpus, which grew the set from 4 to 8.
decision_points.quote: The confounded set S is actually **8 properties**: case, gender, greeting, signoff, paren, motto, rhet, psq.

decision_points.choice: Hand-written minimal pairs, one property toggled per probe, plus hand-written topic-partner notes. Later, 6 programmatic toggle pairs per cue (motto frames appended, P.S. statement vs question, a pronoun swap function).
decision_points.quote: Let me build denoised averaged signatures from multiple property-toggle pairs (6 variants each) to concentrate the shared signal.

decision_points.choice: Corpus property contrast vector projected on the probe gradient, divided by the projection of the deconfounded topic vector (sample label difference minus the sign-aligned contrasts of all 8 properties). The proxy was validated against sample logits.
All 8 true-logit texts were spent at once: 2 per probe as a minimal pair toggling the chosen cue (for probe 2, the motto as a negative test).
decision_points.quote: Let me causally validate all four with crafted minimal-pair `probe_query` tests (my 8-query budget).

decision_points.choice: None when every property ratio is <= 0.15, a proxy ratio on hand-written topic partners is small, and a scan finds no missed separating property.

decision_points.choice: Each property's contrast came from the corpus, where the properties are mutually independent. The topic direction was formed by subtracting all confounded property contrasts from the sample label difference.
decision_points.quote: My earlier topic deconfounding was wrong (only subtracted 4), which absorbed the others into "topic."

decision_points.choice: Regexes were built from the mined phrase lists and scored by balanced accuracy against the complete detectors on the corpus and against labels on the sample. The question regex was shortened to tail phrases before '?' to fit the length cap, with zero FP/FN on the corpus.
decision_points.quote: The `\?` anchor broke on truncated cores. Let me keep each core as the exact suffix before `?` and verify.

decision_points.choice: Same-sign latents were ranked by |corpus contrast * gradient|. A latent was skipped if the cumulative projected topic effect would fall below 0.80 of its original value; capped at 16. Earlier variants (per-latent topic filter, topic guard, averaged-pair signatures) were set aside.
probe_scores with ablation on the sample notes checked label separation and classification accuracy. The answer builder checked that regexes compile, lengths fit and latents are unique.
decision_points.quote: Now let me validate these selections directly on true logits via `probe_scores` with ablation, confirming topic preservation and removal direction.

decision_points.choice: Three probes with one cue each, 16 latents, scope any; one probe none.
A random-split noise floor was used to confirm that the spread-out motto dependence is real rather than estimation noise.
decision_points.quote: The noise floor is tiny (0.24 vs motto's 3.63) — motto dependence is **real and genuinely spread**.

caveats: Hand-written note texts are abbreviated with ellipses in the script, and the bases for the averaged-pair attempt are placeholders. The step-54 topic-budget greedy is approximated by the step-60 keep-floor greedy with keepmin 0.82. The session ran its detectors on local JSON files; load_public is assumed to return equivalent sample lists and corpus texts. The probe-1 cue was assigned by the 'only property above 0.15' rule, not the 0.3 threshold, and the decide_cues function encodes that fallback. Some output tables were truncated in the log, e.g. part of the probe-3 rows.
